breakpoint.$description: Breakpoint thresholds. The authored set is exhaustive: sm, md and lg are real thresholds, and xl and 2xl are closed in the emitted theme so an xl: or 2xl: utility cannot silently resolve to a value this repository never authored.

container.$description: Container width and prose measures. `page` is the page column; `measure` and `measure-narrow` cap running text. Gutters are spacing tokens, not container tokens.
